project.title: Microbial community diversity in anaerobic digestion
project.description: This study aims to investigate the impact of roxithromycin on the microbial community diversity in sludge anaerobic digestion. The result of sequencing relevanced the diversity was delined with roxithromycin addtion， providing a useful information for practical operation in anaerobic digestion engineering.
